sources.relevance: blockConcurrencyWhile orders events and has a 30-second timeout; retain the existing serialized private registry boundary rather than mixing an authorization fix with a coordination refactor.
Async KV APIs and storage gates are also available on SQLite-backed classes. Maintain the existing API/backend; new result-observation metadata is not claimed as a new atomic completion transaction.
Cloudflare runtime tests use its Vitest integration. This repository instead retains its existing Node synthetic-storage suite; no real Workers storage/runtime claim follows from those tests.

decisions: No namespace, backend, class, migration, binding, permission or dependency changes.
Keep Node test infrastructure and label synthetic storage, controlled-clock and DOM-adapter scope honestly.
Fresh clock decisions after asynchronous reads are required even when concurrent events are serialized.
